full_text:
ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35948, December 30, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026; provided, with respect to Presidential Decrees amended under Article 4 of the Addenda that have been promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived, the provisions amending such Presidential Decrees shall enter into force on the enforcement dates of the respective Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to other statutes and regulations) Paragraphs (1) through (105) Omitted.
(106) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education is partially amended as follows:
In Article 4(2)1, "Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of Education" is replaced with "Ministry of Education", and "Ministry of Gender Equality and Family and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries" is replaced with "Ministry of Gender Equality and Family, the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and the Ministry of Planning and Budget".
Paragraphs (107) through (176) Omitted.
